profile.headline: Software Developer at Digilock
profile.summary:
Hard-working, young, versatile, responsible and devoted engineer, with a positive mindset. Always willing to do what is necessary to get the job done and motivated to improve and grow. Experience with designing implementing, testing, and delivering back-end and web applications. Skills include:

Programming languages: Java, Ruby, JavaScript, HTML, Python, ES6, Swift

Database: MySQL, MongoDB, PostgresSQL

Technologies: AJAX, Git, M.E.A.N., Django, React, Socket.io

positions.title: Scrum Master / Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Led a small team of engineers on various projects from design to later stages
• Designed and built the back-end for most of the projects
• Lead algorithm sessions, created and delivered skill building breakout sessions, and delivered curriculum to the students of Coding Dojo
